title: My Ally
description: My Ally is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that lets you mark players as allies by customizing how their nicknames appear
body:
# My Ally
**My Ally** is a Fabric client-side mod that allows you to manually add players as allies by entering their nickname and customizing its appearance.

**Default keybind for opening menus is Y**
![Keybind](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f60fec0f479e1424208195a5db2f9c3e02d47b0b_0.webp)

You can assign each player a unique color, choose between a **simple** colored name or a **brighter highlighted style**, and optionally add a **small symbol** next to their name. 

The mod works **only visually** and applies to the name **above** the player and in the **TAB list**, without affecting gameplay, combat, or visibility, making it **ideal** for PvP and team play to easily distinguish teammates.
